name: Kling v2.6
description: Kling v2.6 generates cinematic 5- or 10-second videos with synchronized audio from text prompts or a base64-encoded starting image. It supports 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 aspect ratios, with optional negative prompts and standard or pro quality modes.

examples.name: Generate a Cinematic Mountain Sunrise
examples.description: Create a widescreen video of a hot-air balloon drifting over a mountain valley at sunrise, with synchronized audio.

input.prompt: A cinematic wide shot of a red hot-air balloon drifting above a mountain valley at sunrise, the camera slowly tracking forward as golden light breaks through the clouds.
